evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: The constrained LM demonstrated improved distributional fidelity and co-occurrence in a 5,000-patient simulated testbed (parameters within published clinical ranges) compared to an empirical sampler, maintained near-chance detectability after a small lambda-sweep, and exhibits temporal adherence by construction.

declaredVenue: Preprint (pre-review version, 6 pages, 2 figures). Accepted at SECURE AI4H@AAAI 2026, Singapore. Extended version to appear in Springer CCIS vol. 3004 (2027): https://link.springer.com/book/9789819239238
